The vendor advisory identifies this exact CWE-401 availability mechanism, about 24-32 bytes per call, with no memory corruption and JRuby unaffected.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: d20552c9a3e3def794bb9a74e6f14cab64b5342a is the first public commit found by reverse -S history to write StringValueCStr(entry) in the allocated transform-parameter loop.
